# cpanel_locale (Data Source)

Reads the display locale for the cPanel account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_locale" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) The singleton account identity, always `account`.
- `direction` (String) The locale text direction: `ltr` or `rtl`.
- `encoding` (String) The character encoding reported by cPanel.
- `local_name` (String) The locale name written in its own language.
- `locale` (String) The abbreviated locale name returned by cPanel.
- `name` (String) The locale name translated into the current cPanel locale.
